description: CAMS Dashboard is the user interface for the Critical Asset Management System, maintained by CriticalAssetManagement contributors. It lets users enter and edit critical assets, view them on an OpenStreetMap map, and inspect a list; the broader CAMS project describes links between assets and potential failure chains. Users provide asset locations and other asset details through forms, and the interface displays the resulting inventory and map. Coverage is limited to places and assets entered by a user; the README offers a Miami local demo, not a verified national inventory. The public source repository has Apache-2.0 metadata. A local Docker demo is documented; the optional hosted TerminusCMS configuration requires an account and token. The dashboard can prepare asset and dependency information for disaster impact or cascading-failure scenarios, but its README does not establish a validated simulation engine or prediction accuracy. The related QGIS platform maps spatial data, while CAMS focuses on structured critical-asset entries. No hosted account, dataset or executable was accessed.
